title: Do not waste your money
text: Do not waste your money. These are beautiful cups but what is the point when the glass is so thin they arrive either cracked or broken in pieces .  3 of the 4 cups where broken . This is unacceptable . Where is the quality control ?  I returned mine .

product_metadata.title: Red Co. 13 fl oz Classic Tea Coffee Clear Glass Cups — Set of 4 Mugs
features: This classically designed glassware makes an ideal addition to any modern table setting — it's a perfect mug to enjoy your morning cup of joe and have a lovely warm chat with friends and family

Ideal for everyday use with hot or cold beverages — pour in your favorite coffee drink, gourmet tea, fresh cappuccino or cream latte, ice cold chocolate milk or even a nice hot cocoa with marshmallows and enjoy a sip or two or three

This SET OF 4 mugs makes for a lovely housewarming present for bachelors or hosts, any friends and family, or even as a wedding gift to help those two love birds start their kitchen collection with elegance
Made of high quality heat resistant clear glass, so lightweight yet so durable — Dishwasher Safe
Capacity of 13½ fluid ounces (roughly 400-425 mL, 1.7 cups) — Dimensions: 4" diameter (5½ with handle) and 3" tall (76mm)
